contracts.asserts: Per-stream scheduling, first-axis manual preemption, bounded pending frames, generation validation, full-queue recovery, unlocked endpoint calls and lifecycle cancellation

limits: Host kernel/endpoint calls are stubs. Native cases exercise real threaded input, listeners, work/mutexes and controlled endpoint acceptance. Actual USB/BLE congestion, delivery/reconnect and physical latency remain unvalidated. Synchronous input and unrelated direct HID writers are not supported by the serialization contract.

execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

kernel.setup: Run in an already resolved owner west workspace; no fetch or revision changes
kernel.asserts: Twelve groups: previous eight plus move/scroll settings invalidating queued tokens and completing while accepted endpoint submission is blocked; all ordered values, time and independence assertions retained
kernel.backend: native_sim//zmk_test_mock, production driver/ZMK HID/kernel APIs, wrapped transport only

fixtures.asserts: Actual full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partially measured reports; normal full entry still measures actual per-function lines/branches
Supported clean dependency pins, safe layout/output, pinned custom-settings archive/digest admission; identity and digest bypass controls
Existing directories, directory symlinks and dangling symlinks preserve prior evidence and invoke no west command
Both Docker/core variants, readonly source, fresh absolute output, existing/link/dangling evidence protection, retained selected online manifest on failure and child exit propagation

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

shared_hid.asserts: Pending report intact against the actual input listener; queued manual X before old token and Y/SYNC after it cancels another stream on first axis, preserves exact first frame, discards stale output and clears final fields
shared_hid.negative_control: Append counterexample on the pre-fix source; named assertion must fail 3/3; original fixture externally preserved; bypass-manual on current source removes only the manual listener processor and requires the named stale-frame assertion 3/3
shared_hid.automatic_entry: tests/integration/run.sh (same standalone owner command; three repeats)

suppression_scope: No source-button/final-frame policy. Retain scheduled motion token admission, first-axis cancellation and input-thread HID serialization; final source filter is not a global output interceptor.
runtime_settings: Public runtime API, actual-source adapter, all100 percentage round trips and coupled thresholds; real kernel settings cancellation plus DYA registry/NVS reload; tests/README.md
